class.name: DisPduBase
class.brief_description: Base class of all PDU objects; holds the common header fields and [method encode].
class.description: Every PDU class ([DisEntityStatePdu], [DisFirePdu], ...) derives from DisPduBase. It holds the fields of the 12-byte DIS header that are not fixed by the class: [member protocol_version], [member exercise_id], [member timestamp] and [member pdu_status]. The PDU type and protocol family are fixed by the class and read with [method get_pdu_type] and [method get_protocol_family]. Subclasses add the body fields and a static [code]decode()[/code] method; [method DisPdu.decode] picks the right one from the type byte. [method encode] writes the PDU as big-endian DIS bytes with the header length filled in. Bytes that a sender put after the last field godot-dis knows, and the protocol family byte if the sender wrote a different one, are kept when decoding and written back when encoding, so a decoded PDU encodes to the same bytes it came from. [codeblock] var pdu := DisEntityStatePdu.new() pdu.entity_id = Vector3i(1, 1, 7) pdu.timestamp = DisPdu.timestamp_from_seconds(Time.get_unix_time_from_system(), true) var bytes := pdu.encode() var copy := DisEntityStatePdu.decode(bytes) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] DisPduBase itself has no body; its [method encode] returns an empty array. Use one of the subclasses.

method.name: encode
method.description: Serializes the PDU to DIS bytes (big-endian) with the header length field set. Returns an empty [PackedByteArray] and prints an error if the PDU cannot be represented, for example when it would exceed 65535 bytes, has more than 255 variable parameters, or has a list that does not fit its count field. Also returns an empty array on a plain DisPduBase.

method.name: get_length
method.description: Returns the encoded size in bytes: the fixed and variable fields the class knows about plus the size of [member trailing_bytes]. For a successfully encoded PDU this equals the size of the array returned by [method encode].

method.name: get_pdu_type
method.description: Returns the PDU type number of this class, one of the [enum DisPdu.PduType] values. Abstract classes such as DisPduBase and [DisWarfarePdu] return 0.

method.name: get_protocol_family
method.description: Returns the protocol family number of this class: 1 for Entity Information ([DisEntityStatePdu], [DisCollisionPdu]), 2 for Warfare, 4 for Radio Communications, 5 for Simulation Management. DisPduBase itself returns 0. This is the class's own family. If a decoded packet carried a different family byte, that byte is kept and written back by [method encode], but is not reported here.

members.member: Exercise ID (header byte 1, 0-255). Receivers usually ignore PDUs of other exercises.
PDU Status (header byte 10), the DIS 7 bit field for things like the transferred-entity and LVC indicators. Kept as received; 0 if unused.
Protocol version (header byte 0). 7 is DIS 7 (IEEE 1278.1-2012), 6 is DIS 6. The decoders accept versions 1 to 7.

Raw 32-bit header timestamp (units of 3600 s / 2^31 past the hour, shifted left by one bit; lowest bit set = absolute time). Build it with [method DisPdu.timestamp_from_seconds] and read it with [method DisPdu.timestamp_to_seconds]. Only the lower 32 bits are written.

Bytes inside the PDU's length field that follow the last field godot-dis decodes, such as vendor extensions or sender padding. They are set by the decoders and appended by [method encode]. Empty for PDUs you create yourself.
